text:
pagerduty: PAGE: kv-cache fragmentation surge on gpu-pool-a — multiple cudaMalloc OOMs and high allocator slowdowns. Trigger: 5xx rate up 3x. P1.

jin: I'm oncall, looking at metrics now. Observing continuous-batching spike at 12:07 UTC, per-token KV growth not being reclaimed.

sam: any obvious customer impact? latency or errors?

jin: yes — p99 gen latency up, and ~4% requests returning 500 with 'cudaMalloc out of memory' in runtime logs. Affected models: rdx-v2-medium on batch-heavy endpoints.

priya: suspect torch allocator fragmentation w/ recent batch changes + quantization toggles. Seen similar in staging when batch cap removed.

maria: let's throttle batching and apply arena tune: set PYTORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=max_split_size_mb:128

jin: canarying change now to us-east-1-canary: updating runtime config to enforce batch_limit=4 and setting env var.

```bash
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/redwood-runtime TORCH_CUDA_ALLOC_CONF=max_split_size_mb:128
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/redwood-runtime REDWOOD_RUNTIME_BATCH_LIMIT=4
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deploy/redwood-runtime
```

ops-bot: applied to canary, rollout started (deploy/redwood-runtime). Watch pods come up.

jin: also triggered an admin eviction of hot keys to immediately free KV growth.

```http
POST /admin/kv/evict
Content-Type: application/json
{ "prefix": "session-hot-" }
```

priya: note — this is a safe short-term eviction; we need a longer-term allocator fix (arena compaction or upgrade to patched torch allocator).

maria: canary metrics: cuda OOMs down 60% after 2 mins, median latency back to baseline. I'll promote to full region after 5m stable.

sam: good. notify CS for impacted customers (no data loss, degraded latency). @maria take ownership for postmortem and follow-up with ML runtime team.

jin: handing off to maria for the rest of the incident. I'll be reachable if it regresses. :thumbsup:

maria: ack. creating incident doc and linking logs. Will include timeline, root cause hypothesis (allocator fragmentation + removed batch cap), and remediation plan (hotfix, arena tuning, and test for future canaries).

pagerduty: Incident INC-2025-1423 created. Escalation to level 2.
